ai-tools.title: AI-powered analyzers
ai-tools.blurb: Drop in an address or a Zillow link — get a full deal memo, comp set, or CMA in under a minute. The same engine that powers RealtyBoss follow-up.

deal-analyzer.name: AI Real Estate Deal Analyzer
deal-analyzer.description: Paste any property URL or address — get a one-page AI deal memo covering condition, risks, comps, and target price. ~30 seconds.

link-analyzer.name: AI Zillow / Redfin Link Analyzer
link-analyzer.description: Drop a Zillow or Redfin URL. The AI pulls listing details, condition signals from photos, comp benchmarks, and a price defensibility take.

cma-analyzer.name: AI CMA Analyzer
cma-analyzer.description: Auto-pull comparable sales and produce a CMA-style price range with full reasoning, ready to share with a seller.

smart-cma.name: Smart CMA Builder
smart-cma.description: Interactive CMA — adjust comp weights, recommend a price range, and export a branded PDF. Under 5 minutes per CMA.

investment-analyzer.name: Property Investment Analyzer
investment-analyzer.description: Cap rate, cash-on-cash, NOI, and 5-year IRR on any rental in under 3 minutes. Saved scenarios stay on the deal.

rental-analyzer.name: Rental Property Analyzer
rental-analyzer.description: Side-by-side rental analysis with rent estimates, expense defaults pre-filled from local averages, and stress-test scenarios.

report-generator.name: Property Report Generator
report-generator.description: Drop an address — get a 6-page branded PDF report covering market context, comps, valuation, and neighborhood data.

buyer-tools.title: Calculators for buyers
buyer-tools.blurb: Send a buyer a custom, branded calculator they can play with — see what their monthly payment, affordability, or rent-vs-buy story actually looks like.

mortgage.name: Mortgage Calculator
mortgage.description: Principal, interest, taxes, and insurance with adjustable down payment and rate. Branded share link for any client.

affordability.name: Affordability Calculator
affordability.description: Income-based price range with debt-to-income gating. Show buyers what they can actually qualify for.

down-payment.name: Down Payment Calculator
down-payment.description: How much you need at closing — down payment + closing costs + reserves — at any price point.

rent-vs-buy.name: Rent vs Buy Calculator
rent-vs-buy.description: Break-even analysis with appreciation, tax benefits, and opportunity cost. Drops the renting-forever myth in 30 seconds.

closing-cost.name: Closing Cost Estimator
closing-cost.description: Itemized closing costs by state — title, transfer tax, escrow, prepaids. Surfaces surprises before they happen.

refinance.name: Refinance Calculator
refinance.description: Break-even on a refinance with closing costs included. Pairs well with rate-shopping outreach to past clients.

arm.name: ARM Calculator
arm.description: Model 5/1, 7/1, and 10/1 ARMs against a fixed 30-year. Worst-case payment included so the conversation is grounded.

investor-tools.title: Calculators for investors
investor-tools.blurb: The income-property math that decides whether to make the offer. Cap rate, cash flow, ROI — all editable, all shareable.

cap-rate.name: Cap Rate & ROI Calculator
cap-rate.description: NOI, cap rate, and ROI for any rental in under a minute. Pair with the Investment Analyzer for the full DCF model.

cash-flow.name: Cash Flow Calculator
cash-flow.description: Monthly and annual cash flow with vacancy, maintenance, management, and reserves. Stress-test before you offer.

roi.name: ROI Calculator
roi.description: Total return on invested capital including financing leverage. Compare scenarios side by side.

seller-tools.title: Tools for sellers
seller-tools.blurb: Capture seller leads with an instant home value estimate, then turn the address into a CMA and a listing presentation.

home-value.name: Home Value Estimator
home-value.description: AI-backed home value range for any U.S. address. Embed the widget on your IDX site to capture seller leads.

cap-rate-by-city.name: Cap Rate by City
cap-rate-by-city.description: Typical cap rate ranges for major U.S. markets — useful when pricing income properties against local comps.
